title: Sloboda Ukraine
capsule: Sloboda Ukraine (Slobozhanshchyna) was a historical Cossack frontier region in the northeastern Ukrainian lands, settled in the 17th century under the protection of the Tsardom of Russia and organized into autonomous Cossack regiments. It enjoyed self-governing privileges (slobody) around Kharkiv until Catherine II abolished its autonomy in 1765, converting it into the Sloboda Ukraine Governorate. It was a borderland region, not a sovereign state.
